relevance_note: The paper describes two members of a Dutch family (P1 mother, P2 daughter) with HA20 due to a novel TNFAIP3 variant: "a heterozygous NM_001270508.2: c.608T > G, p.(Leu203Arg) missense variant of TNFAIP3 in both patients".
method_note: Read the paper (main text, Table 1, figure legends, supplementary material) and transcribed Table 1 and Supplementary Table 1 by hand; no script was used. In-scope people: P1 (mother), P2 (daughter), the brother of P1 (a relative described in the Fig. 1 legend: 'Brother of P1 passed away at the age of 40, had been residing abroad, and had a known medical history of rheumatism and thyroid disease'), and L001, a person with a TNFAIP3 variant ('L001 (CVID patient control with TNFAIP3 LoF mutation c.1309del (p.Ala437Profs))') who is described as a patient control in the Fig. 2 legend and Supplementary Table 1; L001 and the brother each get one row only. Excluded: the TNFRSF13B c.310T > C (p.Cys104Arg) variant in the mother, which the authors call 'a known risk factor that is present in 0.3%–0.5% of the normal population'; no variant row was made for it. No variant row for the brother of P1: the paper does not attribute any variant to him. Table 1 gives 'Age at onset' (18 years for P1, 9 years for P2); no age at diagnosis of HA20 is stated, so age_at_diagnosis_* is 'not reported' and the Table 1 value was recorded as age at onset. The text says P2 'had experienced recurring oral and genital ulcers since adolescence' while Table 1 states an age at onset of 9 years; both are recorded (onset from Table 1, onset text for the ulcer row). No stacked ' / ' cells were present in any table (Table 1 and Supplementary Table 1 have one value per cell); the multi-line cells in Table 1 were read as one cell each. Table 1 has patients as rows, so Table 1 spans quote a contiguous row segment. is_proband is false for all four people: the paper never uses 'proband' or 'index case'; a few boolean fields (is_proband, cites_prior_report_of_same_patients) are false with no span because the paper is silent. The mother's B-cell depletion is treatment-related (rituximab) and was not recorded as a feature; the cytopenia (autoimmune) checklist item was marked observed for P1 from 'leukopenia due to low neutrophil counts' and for P2 from immune-mediated thrombocytopenia. 'without features typical of vasculitis' was recorded as excluded vasculitis for P1 at that time point, while her skin biopsy-confirmed leucocytoclastic vasculitis is recorded as observed (both rows kept; the checklist item vasculitis is therefore set to observed, see phenotypic_features).

the p.Leu203Arg mutation introduces a larger, positively charged residue into the hydrophobic protein core
mutant A20 expression was consistently reduced, while levels of TRAF6 and, to a lesser extent, phosphorylated IκBα were increased following TNFα stimulation
we observed significantly higher levels of phosphorylated STAT1 in the patients
